blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Prosecution witness and financial forensic analyst Atty. Alexander Cabrera has corrected the defense lawyer on deck after the latter used the word “alleged” while claiming to be reading his report on Vice President Sara Duterte’s business interest, saying these remarks are not in the document. During the resumption of Duterte’s impeachment trial on Monday, Cabrera was being quizzed by counsel for the respondent Kristine Ferrer regarding the companies that his report financial focused on as the vice president’s business interests.
